title: While Loops: Read Until Done
learning_objectives: Stop a loop with a sentinel value and break
Keep running totals, counts and maxima
hints: Use `while True:` and read `line = input().strip()` at the top of the loop.
Update the maximum with `if largest is None or x > largest: largest = x`.

failure_feedback.advice: Start `largest` at `None`, not 0, so negative maxima work.
Strip each line before comparing it with `done`.
Break as soon as you see `done`; ignore anything after it.
If `done` comes first, print the initial values: 0, 0 and None.
